paragraphs: Yehudah bar Oshaya, in Chelek. They asked Yehudah bar Oshaya, who did not know; Rav Mattana, who did not know; then Rav Yehudah: Eruvin, source פ׳ ח׳ [checked at 80a:20]. He peeled a spleen for Levi son of Rav Huna bar Chiyya: Chullin 93a.
